name: @hardcover/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for the Hardcover GraphQL API

scripts.codegen: node ../../scripts/case-operations.mjs --case camel --out .operations && node ../../scripts/validate-operations.mjs --dir .operations && graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts && node scripts/gen-shared.mjs
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm codegen && git diff --exit-code -- src/generated && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- src/generated)"
